name: persillade
instructions:
The french parsley-garlic condiment, food-processor method.

=== INGREDIENTS ===

- parsley
- garlic
- olive oil
- champagne vinegar

=== PROCEDURE ===

Everything in a FOOD PROCESSOR. Pulse to a coarse, spoonable condiment.
notes:
=== THE CHAMPAGNE VINEGAR SLOT ===

Champagne vinegar is the acid — the delicate/raw-condiment register is exactly its home ([[mcfadden-cucumber-salad]] logic: champagne for raw and delicate, sherry for warm and earthy, round white wine/white balsamic for cream).

=== FOOD PROCESSOR TERRITORY ===

Parsley is the herb that DOESN'T work in a mortar (too fibrous — the [[italian-green-sauce-and-pesto]] pestle rule), which makes persillade natural food-processor territory. Same coarse-not-puree discipline as [[relish]].

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[relish]]: the pickle-register food-processor condiment; this is the french-green one.
- [[dijon-vinaigrette]] / [[cream-vinaigrette]]: the dressing family.
- [[leeks-vinaigrette]] / [[braised-turnips]]: braised vegetable sides that would take this well.
